comparison_rule.coverage_factor: Use published benchmark coverage convention; k=2 only for compatible standard uncertainties and an approximately 95% interval
comparison_rule.expanded_uncertainty_handling: Convert to standard uncertainty only when coverage factor and distribution convention are known; otherwise use like-for-like published expanded intervals or report that compatibility cannot be tested
comparison_rule.covariance_handling: Set covariance zero only when relevant calculation and measurement components are defensibly independent; where known common-mode effects exist, obtain covariance or a defensible bound
comparison_rule.compatibility_vs_qualification: Passing the uncertainty compatibility check is evidence of consistency at stated coverage, not model qualification; assess domain relevance, systematic bias, model-form error, uncertainty completeness, and numerical verification separately
comparison_rule.monte_carlo_precision: numerical precision target chosen after pilot; report achieved precision; it does not define experimental agreement tolerance
